title: Unit Event — Same Dreams, Same Colors

meta.Outline: Kohane and the rest of VBS continue practicing in pursuit of greater growth. However, Toya finds himself struggling to understand the vision that his teammates have for a song due to his lack of life experience. That's when Luka offers some advice!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I did it...!
My voice held up all the way through to the end!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that was very good.
Next, we'll have...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, me! I'll go next...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, take it away.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nice. Your voice feels more powerful compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! That was so cool, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. Right?
Doing all those street practices was totally worth it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll go next.
Get ready!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Shiraishi began acting a little strange after Azusawa started practicing with Taiga...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But she seems to be back to her old self now. As a result, we seem to be working better as a team.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do to help maintain what we have now...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, I can tell them about the book on vocalization that I bought the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'll just have to keep contributing to this team by using whatever knowledge I have.)
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That was great! Another day full of singing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I feel all warm and cozy inside after singing so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me too.
Also, I'm glad that we have the option of meeting in SEKAI since it was raining in the park today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It wasn't just raining. It was cold too. We would've all gotten sick if we did practice out there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but Taiga mentioned how he'd practice even if it rained.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? Seriously?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes.
He said, “If you clear your mind of mundane thoughts, even rain will feel warm.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Practicing in the rain like it's nothing is totally something he'd do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hold on, Kohane. He didn't make you do that, did he?! There's no way that can be good for you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, we didn't do anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He also mentioned how the rain doesn't bother him because he's never caught a cold before, so it's not something he recommends to others!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: At the same time, the way he practices did seem a little strange...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Strange how?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For starters, he had me listen to all sorts of different music and asked me what I thought.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What you thought?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. But not my opinion, like if I thought an artist was good or if I liked the chorus for a song...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He wanted me to compare music to places or scenery, such as being in a field of sunflowers or seeing the sun set over the sea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really?
How's that supposed to help...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is it a sensitivity thing? Does he want you to feel more? After all this time, I still can't get a read on him...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Haha...
It definitely wasn't practice in the traditional sense of the word...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I feel like there's a deeper meaning. I'll keep trying my best to relay what I learn to you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, for our next step...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shall we proceed with discussing which songs we should add to our repertoire?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I brought a few candidates, so let's see if we can listen to them at MEIKO's place!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That person... The one that's been following us. Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Oh...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Luka?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Huh...? Hey, it's you guys!
Long time no see♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's so great to see all of you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Where have you been all this time?
We haven't seen you at the cafe at all...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. I was having so much fun wandering around this SEKAI that I seem to have lost track of time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We may have just missed each other while I was out and about...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! That's Luka for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope we'll be seeing more of each other from now on. It'd be really nice to sing with you again!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds wonderful!
How about right now?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, really! Let's celebrate our reunion! What do you say, Akito, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure. We haven't seen each other in quite some time, so why not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'll bite.
Greeting each other by singing does have a nice ring to it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Alright, everyone, get ready!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'll count us in.
One, two, three, four...
song00005_off_s

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The way Luka sings has so much depth to it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (She sounds so free, while being flexible enough to complement the way someone else sings.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It's like she's... At ease.
It'd be great to learn to sing like this.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wow, we really cut loose there, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that felt great!
Gimme five, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
High five!
Hehe. And you guys were as good as ever.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I take that back. You've all improved quite a bit, no? It's like you're all singing with much more clarity now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it's that noticeable, then that means all our hard work's actually paying off.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
Let's keep this pace up moving forward.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Guys, why don't we have Luka join us while we discuss which songs to add to our repertoire?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're adding new songs?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. We want to try something that we've never done before, so we each came up with some candidate songs and want to see which might work best for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why it'd be great to hear what you have to say, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so too.
Would you mind, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course! I'd be more than happy to help! Now then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, we've listened to every song that we brought now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's start making our final selections. Or should I say...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The four of you seem to have already come to a decision.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, the way you all reacted to it compared to when you listened to everything else...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Shiraishi's song does seem to be our favorite option.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree. I really want to try singing that song. It's a little different from what we usually do, but it sounds so hip and cool!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Awesome!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We've reached a consensus.
Let's divvy up parts and give it a go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
We'll give it a few more listens and then try it from the top.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I didn't expect to see you here again, Luka. I mean, you're like KAITO when it comes to exploring and wandering around this place...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You all missed me quite a lot, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not really.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, stop!
I know you did♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You never change, huh, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I'm glad that I came back right as they were picking out a new song. I'm really looking forward to seeing how to practice it from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As for my part, I have a feeling this section is going to give me some trouble...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, that was great!
It's definitely a tricky section, but you were pitch-perfect!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was? Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a feeling that this section would sound amazing if we gave it a clearer feel.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A clearer feel...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I just happened to practice a song like this when I was working with Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The way it was sung was so pure and beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I mean... How do I describe that...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was like I was in the middle of a serene forest, I think...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A forest...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. You can hear birds chirping or leaves rustling when you're in a forest, right? But at the same time, it's such a quiet and peaceful place.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I have a feeling that this song will sound just as nice if we can give it that kind of feel...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get what you're trying to say!
There's plenty of beauty within that serenity.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, I have a better understanding now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, it's amazing that you've learned how to express yourself like this, Kohane. You've grown so much!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, my guess is that Taiga had her listen to a wide variety of music to draw these feelings out from within her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At the same time, your suggestion is easier said than done even if we have a better image of what you meant...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, true.
How can we make that happen...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone...
It may sound strange for me to say this now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Aoyagi...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I don't actually know what a forest is like.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've seen them on TV before, but I couldn't tell you what it feels like to be there...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what you meant?
Have you ever gone on one of those field trips to the mountains? You know, when you're supposed to think about what it's like to be surrounded by nature?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An, wait.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, I was never allowed to go because of how I wouldn't be able to play the piano or violin if I hurt my hands...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Aside from field trips, I wasn't allowed to participate in other school events, including sports competitions and such.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, that's right...!
You mentioned that before...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Aoyagi!
I didn't mean to be so inconsiderate...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's okay, really.
That's all in the past now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I need to apologize as well...
Not having experienced what you said has turned into a roadblock for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I had been to a real forest before, I might've been able to understand what you meant when you said, “Quiet and peaceful...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, that's not your fault.
You'll just have to make up for it with your imagination.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I know but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you just go to one?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you've never experienced it before, then why not just go see for yourself? Wouldn't that be the quickest solution?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, using your imagination is great and all, but try describing snow to someone who's never seen snow before. Saying it's “white” or “cold” wouldn't do it much justice, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I have a feeling these sorts of experiences will help you sing better!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have a feeling? That's reassuring...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... But she may have a point.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How people sing can really vary based on their personal experiences. My dad being a prime example of that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, right...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The way Luka sings must have so much depth to it because she's been to many places and experienced so much...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm with Luka on this one.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. I say go and experience as much of the world as you can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That'd be great if we could...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you can't find the kind of peaceful and serene forest Kohane was talking about here. It's not exactly easy to go somewhere like that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (However, Luka's right...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was sure that my knowledge would be what I contribute to this team, but that clearly has its limits.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This may be a good opportunity to experience something new for a change.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I agree completely with what Luka said.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have very little experience with anything other than music, so my hope was that I could use that knowledge to make up for that... But that isn't possible right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, for my own self-betterment, as well as our team's growth...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like it if we could visit a real forest in the near future.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm glad that we decided to visit an actual forest together to improve how we communicate ideas to one another...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Roughly seventy percent of Japan is covered in woodlands. Where would be best in terms of what we wish to accomplish...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Alright, I'll try looking at a few maps during lunch.)
Lunch Break

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, let's get some food... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Dude, where are you going?
Food's that way...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The library.
I'm hoping to find a suitable forest that we can visit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
So, sorry...
I won't be able to have lunch with you today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, it's great that you're excited, but don't go too crazy, alright...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not like we absolutely have to go either. If anything, we could just ask Taiga about the song he introduced to Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, this is too good an opportunity to pass up, and I'd like to do everything I can for our team.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even if we were to find a temporary solution, there's no guarantee that we won't encounter the same problem in the future. I'd like to be prepared for when that happens.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would you be okay with that? Of course, I'll make sure that it doesn't interfere with our practice schedule.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Look, I'm not gonna stop you.
But have you ever gone on a trip like this by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I haven't.
I used to visit Vienna every year with my family, but I was never allowed to go explore on my own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All I could do was see a view of the city or night sky from our hotel room window...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even for contests and competitions, my mom would ferry me to and fro by car.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still can't believe your family's like that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, well...
I understand very clearly now that I grew up in a very special environment.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Conversely, I haven't experienced many of the things that others consider “normal”...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is why I want to check off those boxes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If that's the case, go knock yourself out...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thanks, Akito.
Then, I'm off to the library.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He never budges once he reaches this state. He always sees things through once he's made up his mind.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito!
Having lunch with Toya again?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was planning to, but he ran off to the library to look for a good forest or something.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? He's actually serious about going?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I guess he sort of should if he really does want to go...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, woods and forests can be pretty dangerous depending on where you go. I'm a little worried about his safety.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Knowing him, I'm sure he'll look up everything he needs for it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you might be right to worry about his safety. You never know how dangerous some of these places are until you see it for yourself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we do this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...?
The next day

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Hmm... I can't decide.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (World Heritage Sites, like Shirakami-Sanchi and Yakushima, seem ideal since they contain virgin forests.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But it'll take an enormous amount of time to get to either...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (While all the parks, mountains and forests around here have more or less become popular tourist attractions...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Toya!
Mind if we pop in?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry to catch you during break.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Shiraishi, Akito...
What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: About you going to visit an actual forest... Have you made a decision about where yet?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, not quite?
I'm having trouble finding a suitable location.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Great!
We have an idea regarding that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why don't we all go together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All of us?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You said you want to see a real forest so that we can grow as a team, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you gotta understand that we don't all imagine the same thing when we think about a forest.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you want us to share the same image, then we should all go together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I wouldn't want you to go if it means you have to sacrifice practices...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
I actually think it'll be a great learning experience for all of us!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only that, you might be able to experience more than just the forest if we all go, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: More than just the forest?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, like camping!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Camping? Come to think of it, I've never done that either...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know that you're supposed to pitch a tent and make food using outdoor cookware, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, so why not go camping during our trip into the woods?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito even said that he knows a good spot.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There's this place that we went to as a family a long time ago because Dad wanted to draw somewhere quiet, and I remember there being a huge forest nearby.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I'm pretty sure we can get there by train and bus in around two hours.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's that close...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: On top of that, my family used to go camping a bunch, so we have all the tents and outdoor gear that we could ever need.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So let's take this opportunity to go camping in the woods for a night! It'll be fun, and I'm sure this experience will help us with our song.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A night? As in we'll be sleeping there...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Going there and back all in one day would be pretty rough. I asked Kohane about this yesterday and she said she can go too!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa's also coming?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You heard her. I was worried that her dad wouldn't let her go since he's pretty protective of her, but I guess she managed to get through to him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, he gave her the green light after she told him that we'd be going with her and that it'll be like a training camp where we can work on our singing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I'm really glad that we had a chance to meet him that one time!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm sorry for making you go through all this trouble.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, like I said earlier, this isn't just about you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The rest of us want to do everything we can to become a better team. We're all in this together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If all of us going is the best way to grow as a team, then that definitely seems like the best option.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shiraishi, Akito.
I'm really looking forward to this.
After school the next day
Outdoor Goods Shop

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This place is massive...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, it's a place just for outdoor equipment. Hey, they even have river kayaks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Going down a river does sound fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But a kayak's a bit out of your reach, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... She said she'd be waiting by the central escalator, so she should be close...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An! Over here!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Kohane, there you are!
Sorry for making you wait so long.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, that's okay!
I'm really excited since we don't get to go shopping together all that much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start finding what we need. You still need a sleeping bag, right, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
Something versatile if possible... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What in the world is this mat used for?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's for putting under your sleeping bag. My dad bought some so we're all set there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A mat for a sleeping bag?
I thought a tent and a sleeping bag were all you needed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even if you're in a tent, it gets pretty cold if you sleep on the ground, you know?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
It'd be good to take some along considering how chilly it's been lately.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? What are these? Cans or...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I think those are gas canisters...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that's what you need for camping stoves. You can even use them to make coffee while climbing up mountains and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Freshly brewed coffee does sound nice... Being out in the wilderness may even make it taste just that much better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But all this browsing may not be good for my wallet. Or can I find a way to work them into my budget...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, it's an instruction manual...
Ah, you use this to hang wet utensils and divide up smaller pieces of equipment.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And this ball... You can make ice cream just by putting ingredients into it and rolling it around?!

rows.Speaker: Akito

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Wait, we can see stars...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I don't see it... How can that be?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, right, it's winter and the trees must be in the way... That means I just have to...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-Aoyagi?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
T-Toya, what's gotten into you?!
Why are you climbing that tree?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, I just need to check on something!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: By climbing up a tree?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (My fingers... This bark's so prickly...!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (On top of that, I can't get a good footing. There's so much dew from that mist...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Climbing a tree is harder than I expected...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've done so little with my life...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But that doesn't matter right now!
I just need to focus on climbing!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I should be able to see it now...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There you are, Cassiopeia.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Draw two lines through those five stars, bisect those by drawing a line through the star in the middle, stretch it out to five times its length and...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There it is! The north star!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, he's right...!
If we know where the north star is, we should be able to find our way back!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If we apply this information to our map, we should be able to find our campsite.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Th-Thank goodness...!
Thank you so much, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That was pretty cool...
Nice one, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But one question...
Is it okay for you to be up that high?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Aren't you afraid of heights?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
Aoyagi froze up!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wh-What did you do that for, Akito...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you blaming me?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I... I should be fine...
I managed to climb up... So I should be able to get back down... Right...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-You can do it, Aoyagi...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: H-Hang in there, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Get it together, Toya!
We're all heading back together!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll be fine... I... I can get down...
se_event_camp_2021_005
Campground

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, the skewers and garlic saute are ready! And don't forget to try the cheese fondue...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh wow...! That smells amazing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm glad we prepped everything before we left! All we had to do was heat everything up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Also, Toya, feeling any better?
Your knees looked so wobbly after you managed to climb down from that tree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry about that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Relax, dude.
I mean, we wouldn't have been able to find our way back if it wasn't for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks again, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I believe everyone possesses some sort of “unique talent”.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Looks like Luka was right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh? Did you ring...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Wah...!
Luka?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hi, Luka!
What are you doing on Toya's phone?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Sorry to barge in like this!
Everybody was wondering how you guys were doing out here.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Everybody?
Oh, my phone just flashed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, mine too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whoa, that looks awesome!
Did you guys make all this?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Aww, no fair!!
I wanna do a barbeque too!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Oh, you have tents all set up too!
They seem so nice and cozy!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Don't forget that they're here to work on their new song, you guys. We can't stay too long.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, hello.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sorry, they really wanted to see what was going on after Luka told them how you guys were all having fun camping.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! You're all welcome to join us! The more the merrier!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Still, their barbeque looks amazing.
I wish we could have some...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I agree. We may not be able to have them here, but we could try having our own little barbeque out on the terrace...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You mean it?! I'm in!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yay! Thank you, MEIKO!
Let's grill up a storm♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Haha!
You're way too excited about this, KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's dig in!
For all your hard work, Toya, you get the first skewer! Start us off with a great, big bite!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A great, big bite...?
Do you not un-skewer everything first?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can, but I feel like you should just chomp down on it as it is since we're outdoors!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! Chomp! Chomp!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, this is delicious...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This might be the best thing I've ever eaten.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! That's great!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, this garlic saute's pretty good too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dude, don't hog it all to yourself. Here's yours, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An!
Nom... Yum!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... This skewer has carrots on it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, don't they look nice next to the peppers? You're gonna eat them, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. You can do it, Akito.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: O-Okay, fine...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Can I get your attention, everyone?
se_event_camp_2021_005

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think I have a good idea of how to sing now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would you all mind joining me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's sing our new song...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, that's what we're here for, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that means we get to see your progress. Mind if we listen?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'd like to as well!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you're all more than welcome to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Let's get started.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <What a wonderful song...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is it just me or were we more in sync than usual just now...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought so too. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not like we practiced this together all that much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Looks like I guessed correctly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You knew this would happen?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Only vaguely... It just seemed like we were working well together as a team today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Possibly because we had to work together on things we don't usually do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Things we don't usually do...?
Like pitching tents and cooking...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What does that have to do with singing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm not sure.
But we worked well as a single unit today, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree with you there...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks to you, Toya, this ended up becoming a learning experience for us too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm really glad we decided to do this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, before I forget, I brought marshmallows to roast for dessert!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Nice! Some chocolate sauce would go great with those!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Or sandwiching them between some cookies.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You're drooling all over yourselves.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That reminds me. I saw you sneakily taking pictures throughout the day, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh, you took pictures?
I'd love to see them!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sure... Here we go!
This was when Aoyagi was chopping up the peppers.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You look...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Like I'm dreading it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, look at the way your brow's furled.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, we should take one with all of us in it! It'd be a shame if you weren't in any of them, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, we should.
Also, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Can you send me a copy of what you took later? I'd like to hang some up in my room.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're gonna print them?
Talk about old-fashioned.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, can we take one vertically?
I wanna use it for my home screen♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, we'll take a vertical one and a horizontal one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, your marshmallows are about to burn.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Oh no! Save it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Wow!
It really burned up!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yikes!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I pitched a tent, built a campfire, cooked, explored a forest, got lost, saw some stars and climbed a tree...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (An entire day full of firsts.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When I was little, I felt so trapped sometimes...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Almost as if my entire purpose in life was to stay in my room and immerse myself in sheet music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But that's all changed now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that I'll get to do things that I never imagined doing before moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And what happened today will probably stay with me for the rest of my life...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you...
